meaning:
καπηλεύω
(κάπηλος, a huckster, cf. Isa.1:22 (LXX), Sir.26:29)
to make a trade of (RV, mg., make merchandise of), or perhaps (cf. Isa, l.with) to corrupt (RV, tit.): 2Co.2:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
